description: This file defines a SwiftUI wrapper for the UIKit SFSafariViewController, allowing it to be used within SwiftUI views. It provides a SafariView struct that acts as a UIViewControllerRepresentable, configuring and presenting the Safari browser with optional reader mode.

classes.name: SafariView
classes.description: A SwiftUI wrapper for SFSafariViewController that enables displaying web content within a SwiftUI app.

methods.name: makeUIViewController
methods.description: Creates and configures an SFSafariViewController instance with the specified URL and reader mode setting.

methods.name: updateUIViewController
methods.description: Updates the SFSafariViewController; currently an empty implementation.
